verdict.rationale: Maritime documents recurring background automation: cron triggers wake an agent on a five-field schedule and deliver its prompt on every fire. Agents can also set their own schedules, which the platform syncs into real wake triggers, and the migration docs explicitly cover moving cron jobs and background workers onto agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs execute reliably in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A cron trigger takes a standard five-field expression, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers its `prompt` as a chat message on every fire.
the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers
Move the automation layer of your cloud onto Maritime agents: cron jobs, scheduled functions, background workers, and bots.
Always-on is a flat add-on for the rare agent that must react in milliseconds around the clock.
